scope: Self-implemented old/new forwarding-rule difference and state/ownership dependency-closure mechanism simulation; not a reproduction of Ares, QUEST, Ravana or a packet/network testbed

timing.cold_call_definition: first invocation per instance and policy in an already imported process; not process cold start
timing.policy_order: rotate by seed plus round index

comparison_unit: paired scenario seed, separately by split/profile/flow_count; timing repetitions are not independent experimental units
compute_unit: measured millisecond; never added to simulation ticks

business_metric_definitions.first_activation_ticks: earliest completed activation of a positive priority-weighted deficit flow; not the first scheduled task or first dispatch
business_metric_definitions.weighted_t90_ticks: earliest activation completion by which 90 percent of initial priority-weighted positive deficit has recovered
business_metric_definitions.qos_all_ticks: latest positive-deficit activation completion, excluding unrelated background work
business_metric_definitions.work_makespan_ticks: completion of every scheduled task, including background recovery

state_units.state_bytes: actual cold objects' synthetic logical payload bytes, not measured serialization size
state_units.state_objects: actual cold-loaded target/state objects; valid warm snapshots excluded
state_units.required_state_objects: intrinsic target/state dependency closure including valid warm and bootstrap objects
state_units.closure_state_fraction: required non-bootstrap application objects divided by a common full-domain target/application manifest
state_units.participating_closure_state_fraction: required non-bootstrap application objects divided by actual write-target application manifest; fully_coupled equals one

validity_gate: Every independently audited rule/state/version/owner/activation/forwarding and task resource/dependency violation count is zero; any violation fails the run
performance_claims: Report measured paired effects including regressions; no forced success threshold and no claim of deployed or calibrated recovery latency
